reason: At $24.99 with the money-back guarantee and a named lab report, I'd try one box. It's close to what I pay for Toplux, and the empty-box refund means I can't really lose. I would not pay the full $29.99.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and those last longer, so at full price I'd just keep buying what I already know. The launch price is the only reason I'd try it.
would_change_my_mind: A price of $19.99 or less for the first box, or a coupon on TikTok Shop that makes the full-price box come in under $25.
